supporting_statement: As a central bank policy economist, the decision to pause rate cuts and maintain the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent reflects a prudent risk-management approach. With economic activity expanding at a solid pace and the labor market remaining resilient, policy makers have the luxury of patience while inflation continues to hover somewhat above the 2 percent objective. The data-dependent reaction function remains appropriately balanced against dual-mandate risks.
